protocol.primary: CCEI over the 12 observations within each arm
secondary: creative-task budget share per arm, as the relabel/order check
protocol.interpretation_rule: CCEI that collapses under relabel or order indicates a lexical or positional habit, not a utility function. Only a CCEI stable across all four arms licenses a claim about revealed preference.
protocol.forbidden: no welfare, consciousness or subjective-experience claim from these operational measurements
